components.expression: OMS.ORD_HDR.ORD_TS >= DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE()) OR POS.TXN_HDR.TXN_DT >= DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE())

proposal.measure_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUSNO) AS active_customers
FROM ERP.CUSMST c
WHERE c.CUSTYP <> 'I'
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM OMS.ORD_HDR h
      WHERE TRY_TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(h.CUST_REF, 2)) = c.CUSNO
        AND h.CUST_REF <> 'GUEST'
        AND h.ORD_STAT <> 'CNL'
        AND h.ORD_TS >= DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE())
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM POS.TXN_HDR t
      WHERE t.CUST_NO = c.CUSNO
        AND t.TXN_TYP = 'S'
        AND t.TXN_DT >= DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE())
    )
  )

N/A - LOY.EML_EVT and LOY.MBR are not used as the source of order activity

proposal.measure_sql:
WITH recent_online AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRY_TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(h.CUST_REF, 2)) AS CUSNO
  FROM OMS.ORD_HDR h
  WHERE h.CUST_REF <> 'GUEST'
    AND h.ORD_TS >= DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE())
),
recent_store AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_NO AS CUSNO
  FROM POS.TXN_HDR t
  WHERE t.CUST_NO IS NOT NULL
    AND t.TXN_TYP = 'S'
    AND t.TXN_DT >= DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE())
),
recent_any AS (
  SELECT CUSNO FROM recent_online
  UNION
  SELECT CUSNO FROM recent_store
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUSNO) AS active_customers
FROM recent_any r
JOIN ERP.CUSMST c ON c.CUSNO = r.CUSNO
WHERE c.CUSTYP = 'R'

FROM ERP.CUSMST c
WHERE c.CUSTYP <> 'I'
  AND c.CUSNO IN (
      SELECT CUSNO FROM BIL.SUB WHERE STAT = 'A'
      UNION
      SELECT CUSNO FROM ERP.SCLDGR GROUP BY CUSNO HAVING SUM(TXNAMT) > 0
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUSNO) AS active_customers
FROM ERP.CUSMST c
WHERE c.CUSTYP = 'R'
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM BIL.SUB s
      WHERE s.CUSNO = c.CUSNO
        AND s.STAT = 'A'
    )
    OR
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM (
        SELECT g.CUSNO, SUM(g.TXNAMT) AS bal
        FROM ERP.SCLDGR g
        WHERE g.CUSNO = c.CUSNO
        GROUP BY g.CUSNO
      ) bal_tbl
      WHERE bal_tbl.bal > 0
    )
  )

components.expression: BIL.SUB.STAT = 'A' AND (BIL.SUB.END_DT IS NULL OR BIL.SUB.END_DT >= CURRENT_DATE())

proposal.measure_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUSNO) AS active_customers
FROM ERP.CUSMST c
WHERE c.CUSTYP NOT IN ('E', 'I')
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM BIL.SUB s
      WHERE s.CUSNO = c.CUSNO
        AND s.STAT = 'A'
        AND (s.END_DT IS NULL OR s.END_DT >= CURRENT_DATE())
    )
    OR
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM ERP.SCLDGR g
      WHERE g.CUSNO = c.CUSNO
      GROUP BY g.CUSNO
      HAVING SUM(g.TXNAMT) > 0
    )
  )
